stories.headline: US Refueling Planes Over Middle East, GPS Jammed in Tehran — Strike Window Opens
stories.thesis: US refueling aircraft positioned over Middle East. GPS interference confirmed in Tehran. Iran on full combat alert. The Apache shootdown was 24h ago — no strike yet, but pre-strike posture is confirmed.

stories.headline: Vance Says Iran Deal 'Before Midterms' as US Prepares Strikes — Contradiction at Maximum
stories.thesis: VP Vance claims Iran deal is imminent. Markets price diplomatic resolution — oil below $90, VIX below 17. But US refueling planes are airborne and GPS is jammed in Tehran. The gap between consensus and reality widens.

stories.headline: South Korea Commits $350B to US — Pays Protection Money for Tariff Relief
stories.thesis: South Korea approved $350B in strategic US investments. $200B in strategic industries, $150B for shipbuilding. A template for allies: invest in US industrial base or face tariffs.

stories.headline: Anthropic Releases Claude Fable at 2x Opus Pricing — AI Competition Accelerates
stories.thesis: Anthropic released Claude Fable today — earlier than any analyst expected. Premium enterprise pricing at 2x Opus. Margin expansion narrative for frontier AI companies.

stories.headline: Strategy Resumes Bitcoin Buying Spree — Halts Market Panic at $58K Support
stories.thesis: MicroStrategy resumed Bitcoin accumulation at $58K support. World's largest corporate BTC holder buying halted the panic. Shorts targeting MSTR face capitulation risk.

stories.headline: SpaceX IPO June 12 — 2 Days Away, $1.8T Valuation, OpenAI S-1 Filed
stories.thesis: SpaceX to list on Nasdaq under SPCX at $1.8T+ valuation, raising $80B+. OpenAI confidentially filed S-1. Both at 96x+ revenue — defining capital markets event of 2026.
